queries.compiledQueryString: select distinct year from f1.stints order by year desc
queries.inputQueryString: select distinct year from f1.stints order by year desc

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    round_number,
    short_name,
    compound,
    case compound when 'SOFT' then 1 when 'MEDIUM' then 2 else 3 end as compound_order,
    deg_fuel_corrected_s_per_lap,
    stint_length_laps,
    driver_code
from f1.stints
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and session_name = 'Race'
  and compound in ('SOFT', 'MEDIUM', 'HARD')
  and clean_laps >= 8
  and deg_fuel_corrected_s_per_lap is not null

    round_number,

from f1.stints
